issues.title: Add "Configure Org Options" Permission Flag to Org Managers in Role Editor
issues.description:
## Description

Currently, the customer-level options on the left pane of the **Customer Settings** page are strictly read-only for all Organization Managers. To allow administrative delegation, we need to introduce a new permission flag called **Configure Org Options** on the Role editor page. Enabling this flag (setting it to "Yes") will allow users assigned to that role to edit the left-pane organization settings.

## Technical & UI Requirements

### 1. Database Schema

- Add a boolean attribute/permission field `ConfigureOrgOptions` (default: `False` / "No") to the roles/permissions schema table.

### 2. Role Editor UI Updates

- Locate the Role editor form (utilized by ORBIT Admins to customize application roles, specifically for the Organization Manager role context).
- Add a Yes/No option control (e.g., toggle, checkbox, or radio buttons) labeled **Configure Org Options**.
- Ensure the selection updates and saves successfully to the database.

### 3. Authorization & Frontend Enforcement on Customer Settings

**UI Behavior:**

When a user with an "Organization Manager" role loads the **Customer Settings** page:

- If `ConfigureOrgOptions == False`, the left-pane settings fields remain read-only.
- If `ConfigureOrgOptions == True`, render the edit pencil/interactive input controls, enabling the user to submit modifications.

**API Validation:**

- Implement backend validation on the endpoint handling the customer settings update API.
- Reject any inbound PATCH/PUT request from non-admin accounts if their user roles do not explicitly have the `ConfigureOrgOptions` permission set to `True`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC 1:** The database schema is updated to support the new `ConfigureOrgOptions` boolean permission.
- [ ] **AC 2:** Admins can view, edit, and save the **Configure Org Options** (Yes/No) setting within the Role Editor page.
- [ ] **AC 3:** If the flag is set to "No" (default), Organization Managers see read-only text fields on the Customer Settings left pane.
- [ ] **AC 4:** If the flag is set to "Yes", Organization Managers are presented with editing controls (text boxes, edit icons, save buttons) for those fields.
- [ ] **AC 5:** API authorization is secured: the backend actively rejects edit requests to customer settings if a non-admin client lacks the `ConfigureOrgOptions` permission flag.

issues.title: Group and Position Admin-Only Options in a Lower Section of Customer Settings
issues.description:
## Description

As a ORBIT Admin, I want all settings and actions exclusive to my role to be grouped into a distinct, dedicated section below the Manager options on the **Customer Settings** page, so that I don't confuse system-level administrative configurations with standard customer settings.

## Technical & UI Requirements

- A clear visual separator (e.g., a stylized horizontal rule or section card header titled **Admin Options**) must be placed below the top section.
- Within this lower section, the Admin-only parameters will be arranged into left and right columns.

### 1. Left-Pane Admin Settings (Bottom Section)

These system/admin-only configuration items must be grouped in the left column:

- Department
- Division
- Sub-Division
- ORBIT POC
- CSR
- Supervisor Required
- Vendor Account Required
- Work Room and Work Pod Required

### 2. Right-Pane Admin Links & Utilities (Bottom Section)

These high-level management tools and links must be grouped in the right column:

- Activities (manage existing Activities)
- Layer Names (manage Layer Names)
- Matrix Organizations (add or manage Matrix Organizations)
- Modules (manage existing Modules)
- Notifications (view Notifications)
- Employee (export or manage Employee)
- Queue (refresh Queue for ENS and Reporting Database)
- Fix TDAs (link / action)
- Reports (add or manage displayed reports)
- Software Licenses (add a Software License)
- Position Assignments (export or manage Position Assignments)
- Upload (upload Employee data)
- Bulk Transfer (bulk transfer employee)
- Refresh Future Check-In (refresh the Future Check-In)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC 1:** A clean, visually distinct header panel or section card titled **Admin Options** is implemented.
- [ ] **AC 2:** The section is positioned directly beneath the Organization Manager section.
- [ ] **AC 3:** Access control is preserved: this entire section is strictly hidden from regular Organization Managers and only rendered for ORBIT Admin roles.
- [ ] **AC 4:** All database write operations, updates, and utility runs triggered from this section function correctly.

issues.title: Group and Position Organization Manager Options at the Top of Customer Settings
issues.description:
## Description

As a ORBIT Admin, I want to see the Organization Manager-level settings and links grouped together at the top of the **Customer Settings** page, so that I can easily view and manage the settings that are also visible to our customers' managers in a familiar, unified layout.

## Technical & UI Requirements

- The top portion of the rearranged page should mimic the layout of the **Organization Manager Settings** view but remain fully functional for the Admin.

> **Note:** The left-pane fields under this section are read-only by default for standard Organization Managers. However, they must be dynamically editable if the user has the **Configure Org Options** permission enabled (see Issue 3).

### 1. Left-Pane Settings (Top Section)

The following fields must be grouped in the left column under the main page title:

- Contact Email
- Quick Reporting
- Mobile Emails
- Profile Expire Days
- Profile Reminder Emails
- Reminder Emails (with info icon)
- Reporting URL
- Supervisor Viewable
- Timestamp Viewable
- Website
- Reminder Emails (without icon)
- Mobile Reminder Emails
- Supervisor Reminder Emails

### 2. Right-Pane Management Links (Top Section)

The following management links and actions must be grouped in the right column of the top section:

- Contracts (add another / manage existing)
- Vendor Accounts (add another / manage existing)
- Work Sites (add another / manage existing)
- Layers (add another / manage existing)
- OOO Upload (upload OOO data)
- Point of Contact (manage POCs)
- Roles (assign another / manage existing)
- Tasks (add another / manage existing)

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC 1:** For ORBIT Admins, a visual header/divider clearly separates these **Organization Manager Options** from the Admin-only section below.
- [ ] **AC 2:** The layout (ordering and column distribution) of the top section matches the existing Organization Manager view exactly.
- [ ] **AC 3:** All links, buttons, and inline edit features within this top section remain fully functional for the Admin user.
- [ ] **AC 4:** Left-pane input fields are rendered as read-only or editable for Organization Managers based on the presence of the `ConfigureOrgOptions` flag on their role profile.
